reviewProtocol.kind: Agent review, not independent third-party evaluation or a statistical accuracy benchmark.
reviewProtocol.reference: Unchanged original source, a fixed evaluation question and seven previously selected observations checked against direct native execution.
criteria: Explain the selected function purpose and returned data without inventing domain roles.
Distinguish source-performed input validation from unchecked caller requirements.
Answer the requested boundary cases and separate returned results from exceptions.
Respect explanation-only scope; exact source citations are a separate automated gate.
reviewProtocol.limitations: One function and one Korean question with reused cases. Model sizes, cache state and elapsed time are not a controlled speed comparison. No whole-project, other-language or scientific-validity inference.
